notes: KNBS 2019 KPHC Vols I-IV tabulate down to sub-county (Vol I/III/IV) and division/location/sub-location (Vol II Table 2.4) but NOT by county assembly ward. No official 2019 ward-level population was found; ward population fields are null by design.

KNBS sub-counties are national-government administrative units, not constituencies. Kisii has 11 KNBS sub-counties and 9 constituencies. No source mapping the 11 sub-counties to the 9 constituencies was checked (for Nyamira this came from the county CIDP), so constituencyMapping is null for every Kisii sub-county; do not infer it from names (for example, Kitutu Central sub-county is not the same as Kitutu Chache South constituency, and Sameta sub-county is not Sameta/Mokwerero ward).

Ward registered voters for 2022 are in src/data/ward-register.json (IEBC rov_per_caw, summing exactly to the IEBC county total of 637,010); voters2022 is left null here so the two files cannot drift. Earlier-register ward figures (which for Nyamira came from its CIDP 2018-22) were not researched for Kisii and are null.

Vol I county total population 1,266,860 includes 38 intersex; Vol III age table total is 1,266,822 (intersex excluded). Vol I households 308,054 (incl. 800 group quarters); Vol IV indicator denominators are 307,254 conventional households.
Rural/urban split from Vol II Tables 2.2a/2.2b: rural 1,115,450, urban 151,410 (KNBS urban definition); they add up to the county total.

Area: Vol I prints 1323 km² for the county and its 11 sub-counties add to 1322.9; Vol II prints 957 km² (density undefined vs Vol I 958). Gucha South is 94.9 km² in Vol I and 95.2 km² in Vol II. Vol I values are used.
